subject: Re: MAP checkpoint — Integracom integration timeline & outstanding auth items
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@integracom.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: MAP checkpoint: Integracom integration plan & outstanding auth items

Hi Tom —

Following up on our MAP (attached v2). Wanted to capture a quick weekly checkpoint on the integration workstreams so we have an aligned close timeline and can surface any eval blockers for the pilot by 10/21. High-level asks below; please reply inline with status and owners where possible.

Summary of workstreams / open items:
- SDK integration (JS + Android): need final OAuth redirect URIs and client_id for staging. Owner: Integracom eng.
- API auth: we requested mutual TLS cert exchange; we currently have token-based flow in staging but need to lock prod auth pattern (mTLS vs token). Owner: Integracom Sec / Redwood Security.
- Streaming & session stability: early streaming tests show reconnects on >15min sessions. Need logs and sample traces. Owner: Redwood SRE + Integracom eng.
- Tool-calling mapping: mapping Integracom tool endpoints to Redwood function calls — tech spec in shared Drive. Owner: Monica / Integracom PM.

Proposed near-term dates:
- 10/01: technical sync (30m) to validate SDK auth exchange and streaming reproducer
- 10/12: evaluation run begins (50k tokens)
- 10/21: pilot wrap + close decision (go/no-go)

Action items (please confirm):
1) Provide OAuth redirect URIs and staging client_id — Integracom — due 2026-09-30
2) Share streaming session logs / traces for reconnects — Integracom SRE — due 2026-09-30
3) Redwood to prepare a short reproducer and proposed SLOs for streaming — Karthik — due 2026-10-01
4) Update MAP with revised evaluation milestones & signoff owner — Laura — due 2026-10-02

Attaching: MAP_Integracom_v2.xlsx (baseline timeline), quick evaluation checklist.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@integracom.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: integracom-eng@example.integracom.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: Integracom integration plan & outstanding auth items

Laura — thanks for the clear list. Quick status from our side: 

- OAuth redirect URIs/client_id: we spun up the staging client this morning. Redirect URIs we used for test are https://staging.integracom.com/auth/callback and https://localhost:3000/auth/callback; I'll confirm prod URIs by EOD 9/30.
- API auth: we have token-based auth working in staging. Our security team is evaluating mTLS but will need a short exception if mTLS timeline slips — we can agree a compensating control (short-lived tokens + IP allowlist).
- Streaming: ran a 20m streaming run; saw 2 reconnects at 17:40 and 18:03. I attached the raw logs (integracom-test-results.zip) and a short note from our SRE describing network timeouts on our load balancer.
- Tool mapping: PM working on a mapping doc; expect that by 10/01.

We can do the 10/01 sync at 10:30 PT — Tom, Monica, and one of our eng leads will join. We are OK to start the eval on 10/12 if auth is stabilized.

Attaching: integracom-test-results.zip (SRE logs).

Cheers,
Tom Reynolds
Head of Platform Integrations
Integracom, Inc.
tom.reynolds@integracom.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: Integracom integration plan & outstanding auth items

Laura / Monica — read Tom's logs. Initial take: the reconnects match the LB idle timeout pattern we've seen on other customers. Quick mitigation options: increase keepalive at the LB for the duration of the eval, or use smaller request-chunk windows on the client side to force periodic activity. I can spare an SRE (Sean) to sit with Integracom SRE for an hour this week to run a reproducer.

I'll prepare a short reproducer script and an ops runbook (how to toggle timeouts and where to gather traces). Proposed owner breakdown:
- Reproducer & ops runbook: Karthik (Redwood) — due 10/01
- SRE pairing session: Sean Gallagher (Redwood) + Integracom SRE — schedule 10/01 or 10/02
- Auth exception / compensating control review: Redwood Security + Integracom Sec — track separately in the MAP.

Will update the MAP doc with these items and owners.

-Karthik
Engineering Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@integracom.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: Integracom integration plan & outstanding auth items

Thanks all —

I've updated the MAP spreadsheet with the reproducer and SRE pairing tasks. I've also scheduled a 30-minute technical sync on 2026-10-01 at 10:30 PT (invite sent) to run through redirect URIs, reproduce the streaming disconnect, and confirm the tool-calling mapping scope. Agenda:
1) Auth: confirm redirect URIs + prod client_id plan (Tom)
2) Streaming: reproduce disconnect + runbook (Karthik + Sean)
3) Tool-calling: scope & owner (Monica)
4) Next steps & signoff timeline for eval start (Laura)

Two admin notes:
- I uploaded a draft SOW amendment to capture the short SRE pairing addendum — see SOW-Amendment-Integracom.docx in attachments. If we need a quick DocuSign route for the addendum, I can send a powerform link during the meeting.
- HubSpot deal updated with new milestone dates: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345

Please confirm availability for 10:30 PT. If you can't make it, flag an alternate.

Best,
Laura
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@integracom.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: Integracom integration plan & outstanding auth items

Laura — confirmed, 10:30 worked well for the team. Quick follow-ups after the sync:
- We will provide prod redirect URIs by 10/04 and can open a short-lived token fallback if mTLS is delayed.
- Our SRE paired with Sean during the sync and we reproduced the reconnect; temporary LB keepalive tweak fixed the 20m disconnect for the test run. We'll run a 2-hour stress run next week and share results.
- PM attached a revised MAP with minor timeline moves; attaching final copy here.

Attaching: MAP_Integracom_v2.xlsx (updated 2026-10-02).

Looking forward to the eval start on 10/12.

Thanks,
Tom
